use default

hex_dump(data: ubyte[], start: int, length: int) is
    let offset mut = start
    let end = System.Math.min(start + length, data.count)

    while offset < end do
        let count = System.Math.min(16, end - offset)
        let bytes =
            (0..count) |> map(i => data[offset + i]) |> collect_list()
        let to_hex = b => "{b,0:x2}"
        let first_half = bytes |> take(8) |> map(to_hex) |> join(" ")
        let second_half = bytes |> skip(8) |> map(to_hex) |> join(" ")
        let hex =
            if second_half.length == 0 then
                first_half
            else
                "{first_half}  {second_half}"
            fi
            .pad_right(48)
        let printable = b => b >= 32ub /\ b < 127ub
        let to_ascii_char =
            b => if printable(b) then cast char(b) else '.' fi
        let ascii = bytes
            |> map(to_ascii_char)
            |> map(c => "{c}")
            |> join("")

        write_line("{offset,0:x8}  {hex}  |{ascii}|")

        offset = offset + count
    od

    write_line("{end,0:x8}")
si

let text = "Rosetta Code is a programming chrestomathy site 😀."
let bom = [0xFFub, 0xFEub]
let body = System.Text.Encoding.unicode.get_bytes(text)
let bytes = bom |> cat(body) |> collect_array()

write_line("full dump:")
hex_dump(bytes, 0, bytes.count)

write_line("")
write_line("starting at offset 0x10, 32 bytes:")
hex_dump(bytes, 0x10, 32)
